paragraphs: It is Sunday, and the children are in the park. The sun is hot, and the sky is blue. Ben has new roller skates. He can skate very well. "Look at me!" he shouts. Tom looks at him and says, "I can't skate." Lily can hop, skip, and dance on the grass. But she can't skate. Pip can climb on a big rock, but he can't skate!

"Do you want to try?" asks Ben. "Yes, please," says Tom. "Put on this helmet first," says Ben. "Be careful, Tom!" says Lily. Ben holds Tom's hand. "Go slowly," says Ben. Tom moves his feet a little. Then he falls on the grass. Lily laughs, but Tom is not sad. "I'm safe with my helmet!" he says.

Tom tries again and again. Now he can skate a little. "Look, I can skate!" he says. Pip runs next to him, and he is quick. Tom is tired, but he is very happy. Ben claps and says, "Well done, Tom!" Pip puts one small foot on a roller skate. "Can Pip skate?" asks Ben. "No, he can't!" says Lily. Everyone laughs. Now Tom can skate, but he can't skip!
